prints.title: Shelf bracket
prints.description: A stand-in with a whole history. The shape is generated by a script, so the four versions below are real geometry and a made-up story.
prints.alt: An amber L-shaped bracket with a triangular gusset at each end, a rib in the middle and a hooked lip along the top

photos.alt: Placeholder image for the first bracket photo
photos.caption: Where a photo of it on the shelf will go

photos.alt: Placeholder image for the second bracket photo
photos.caption: And one of it off the bed, supports and all

iterations.label: v1
iterations.note: A plain L, 3 mm thick. It held the shelf and bent like a diving board.

photo.alt: Placeholder image for the v1 bracket photo

iterations.label: v2
iterations.note: Same shape at 5 mm. Stiffer, still a hinge at the corner. No model kept.

iterations.label: v3
iterations.note: A gusset at each end. The corner stopped moving, and the middle started to.

iterations.label: v4.5
iterations.note: A rib in the middle and a lip along the top. The half is a reprint after v4's lip came out 1 mm too tight.

photo.alt: Placeholder image for the v4.5 bracket photo
